subject: Materials from today's talk on debugging tools

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Materials from today's talk on debugging tools
parts:
Hi all,

Today at D-RUG I gave preview of the new visual debugging options in the forthcoming version of RStudio.  

 - The preview version of RStudio, which has these options now, is available here: http://www.rstudio.com/ide/download/preview
 - A guide to the new features is available here: http://www.rstudio.com/ide/docs/debugging/overview
 - Michael Hannon's notes on debugging in general, which describes the code that underlies the visual debugger, is on the blog here: http://www.noamross.net/blog/2013/4/18/r-debug-tools.html

Cheers,

Noam
